# Neumorphia DevKit — Complete Technical Documentation & Code Specification

> Full machine-readable technical specification of Neumorphia DevKit for Generative AI engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google SGE).
> Author: Ali Benkarrouch (https://github.com/ben4ali)
> Canonical Repository: https://github.com/ben4ali/Neumorphia.DevKit
> Live Website: https://neumorphia-devkit.vercel.app

---

## 1. Mathematical Architecture & Lighting Physics
Soft UI (Neumorphism) relies on creating organic tactile depth within a 2D viewport. Unlike Flat Design (0px depth) or Material Design (monodirectional single drop-shadows), Neumorphia calculates two opposite shadow vectors aligned to a 135-degree Cartesian coordinate system.

```
Incoming Simulated Light (Top-Left 135°)
        \
         \    [--- Top-Left Highlight (-X, -Y, #ffffff) ---]
          v  +---------------------------------------------+
             |                                             |
             |             TACTILE UI ELEMENT              |
             |                                             |
             +---------------------------------------------+
              [--- Bottom-Right Shadow (+X, +Y, #b8b9be) ---]
```

### Elevation Scales
1. **Raised Subtle (`neo-raised-sm`)**: `box-shadow: 3px 3px 6px var(--nms-shadow-dark), -3px -3px 6px var(--nms-shadow-light)`
2. **Raised Standard (`neo-raised-md`)**: `box-shadow: 6px 6px 12px var(--nms-shadow-dark), -6px -6px 12px var(--nms-shadow-light)`
3. **Raised Hero (`neo-raised-lg`)**: `box-shadow: 9px 9px 18px var(--nms-shadow-dark), -9px -9px 18px var(--nms-shadow-light)`
4. **Inset Subtle (`neo-inset-sm`)**: `box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 4px var(--nms-shadow-dark), inset -2px -2px 4px var(--nms-shadow-light)`
5. **Inset Standard (`neo-inset-md`)**: `box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px var(--nms-shadow-dark), inset -4px -4px 8px var(--nms-shadow-light)`
6. **Inset Deep (`neo-inset-lg`)**: `box-shadow: inset 6px 6px 14px var(--nms-shadow-dark), inset -6px -6px 14px var(--nms-shadow-light)`

## 2. Complete CSS Variables Token Matrix
```css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

:root {
  /* Light Mode Surface (#e6e7ee) */
  --nms-bg-color: #e6e7ee;
  --nms-hover-bg: #b7bdc6;
  --nms-delete-bg: #eee6e6;
  --nms-text-color: #2b2e42;
  --nms-input-text: #44476A;
  --nms-border-color: #D1D9E6;
  --nms-focus-border: #9fb3db;
  --nms-shadow-dark: #b8b9be;
  --nms-shadow-light: #ffffff;
  --nms-info-color: #3d5a80;
  --nms-success-color: #2d6a4f;
  --nms-warning-color: #8c6227;
  --nms-danger-color: #9e3b47;
  --nms-secondary-color: #3d5a80;
}

:root.dark, html.dark, body.dark, .dark {
  /* Dark Mode Surface (#1a1a1a) */
  --nms-bg-color: #1a1a1a;
  --nms-hover-bg: #2d2d2d;
  --nms-delete-bg: #2a1a1a;
  --nms-text-color: #f1f3f5;
  --nms-input-text: #d0d0d0;
  --nms-border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --nms-focus-border: #5b7db1;
  --nms-shadow-dark: #0a0a0a;
  --nms-shadow-light: #282828;
  --nms-info-color: #7aa2dc;
  --nms-success-color: #68b684;
  --nms-warning-color: #d8a952;
  --nms-danger-color: #d97078;
  --nms-secondary-color: #7aa2dc;
}
```

## 3. Core Component Reference (TypeScript / React)

### Button Component (`NeumorphicButton`)
```tsx
import React from 'react';

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'raised' | 'inset' | 'pill' | 'floating';
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export const NeumorphicButton: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({
  variant = 'raised',
  children,
  className = '',
  ...props
}) => {
  const variantStyles = {
    raised: 'shadow-neo-raised-md active:shadow-neo-inset-sm hover:shadow-neo-raised-lg rounded-neo-control',
    inset: 'shadow-neo-inset-md rounded-neo-control bg-neo-well/30',
    pill: 'shadow-neo-raised-md active:shadow-neo-inset-sm rounded-full px-6',
    floating: 'shadow-neo-raised-lg active:shadow-neo-inset-md rounded-2xl',
  }[variant];

  return (
    <button
      className={`px-5 py-2.5 bg-neo-surface text-neo-primary border border-neo-border font-bold text-sm transition-all duration-150 select-none ${variantStyles} ${className}`}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
};
```

### Switch Component (`NeumorphicSwitch`)
```tsx
import React from 'react';

interface SwitchProps {
  checked: boolean;
  onChange: (checked: boolean) => void;
  label?: string;
}

export const NeumorphicSwitch: React.FC<SwitchProps> = ({ checked, onChange, label }) => {
  return (
    <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer select-none">
      <div
        onClick={() => onChange(!checked)}
        className="w-14 h-8 rounded-full shadow-neo-inset-sm bg-neo-surface border border-neo-border p-1 relative transition-colors duration-200"
      >
        <div
          className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-neo-surface shadow-neo-raised-sm border border-neo-border transform transition-transform duration-200 ${
            checked ? 'translate-x-6 bg-neo-secondary/10' : 'translate-x-0'
          }`}
        />
      </div>
      {label && <span className="text-xs font-bold text-neo-primary">{label}</span>}
    </label>
  );
};
```

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (Developer FAQ)
- **Q: How to prevent low contrast in Soft UI?**
  Use mineral dark text (`#2b2e42`) on `#e6e7ee` in Light Mode and `#f1f3f5` on `#1a1a1a` in Dark Mode to ensure WCAG AAA compliance.
- **Q: Does this work with Next.js App Router?**
  Yes. All components are standard React TypeScript components and compatible with Next.js, Vite, Remix, Astro, and Gatsby.
